```yaml
name: Build macOS binary

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  build-macos:
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pyinstaller

      - name: Sanitize release tag
        run: |
          echo "TAG=$(printf '%s' "${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}")" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Build PyInstaller binary
        run: |
          pyinstaller --onefile --name a2a-scanner --distpath dist src/main.py
        env:
          PYTHONUNBUFFERED: 1

      - name: Create tar.gz archive
        run: |
          tar -czf a2a-scanner-${{ env.TAG }}-arm64.tar.gz -C dist a2a-scanner

      - name: Upload asset to release
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./a2a-scanner-${{ env.TAG }}-arm64.tar.gz
          asset_name: a2a-scanner-${{ env.TAG }}-arm64.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Compute SHA256
        id: sha
        run: |
          echo "sha=$(shasum -a 256 a2a-scanner-${{ env.TAG }}-arm64.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Update Homebrew formula
        env:
          HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git clone https://x-access-token:${HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN}@github.com/cisco-ai-defense/homebrew-ai-defense.git
          cd homebrew-ai-defense
          FORMULA=Formula/a2a-scanner.rb
          sed -i '' -e "s/^  version .*/  version \"${{ env.TAG }}\"/" $FORMULA
          sed -i '' -e "s/^  sha256 .*/  sha256 \"${{ steps.sha.outputs.sha }}\"/" $FORMULA
          git add $FORMULA
          git commit -m "Update a2a-scanner to ${{ env.TAG }}"
          git push origin main
```
